title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378S (Matters to be transacted at general meeting)

content.overview: The Board of Directors of a Producer Company shall exercise the following powers on behalf of that Company only by means of resolutions passed at the annual general meeting of its Members: (a) approval of budget and adoption of annual accounts; (b) approval of patronage bonus; (c) issue of bonus shares; (d) declaration of limited return and decision on the distribution of patronage; (e) specification of the conditions and limits of loans that may be given by the Board to any director; and (f) approval of any transaction of a nature reserved in the articles for approval by the Members.
content.glance: Budget, annual accounts, patronage bonus, bonus shares, limited return/patronage distribution, director-loan limits and article-reserved matters require AGM resolution.
content.study: Section 378S reserves specified important matters for resolution at the annual general meeting. The Board cannot decide these matters on its own; it must act only by means of AGM resolutions. This complements the residual Board powers in section 378R.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The six categories of matter listed in s. 378S may be exercised by the Board only through AGM resolutions of the Members.

provisions.title: Matters to be transacted at general meeting

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378S
examples.body: Approval of the annual accounts and of patronage bonus must be obtained by AGM resolution under s. 378S(a) and (b).

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378S?
hypotheticals.analysis: It reserves specified matters for AGM resolution so that the Board cannot decide them alone.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming the Board may approve the annual accounts without an AGM resolution.
misconceptions.correction: s. 378S requires AGM resolution for approval of budget and adoption of annual accounts.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378S be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the proposed Board action. II. Check whether it falls within s. 378S(a)–(f). III. Require AGM resolution if it does.

examTips: Name s. 378S: Matters to be transacted at general meeting.
